basic_profile.bio: Joe is a 29-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas. He works as a software developer for a fintech startup. Joe has a keen interest in cryptocurrencies and blockchain technology, which he explores in his free time. He dislikes misinformation and enjoys debunking myths on the internet. Joe is single and usually online in the evenings after work, often browsing Reddit and engaging in discussions about technology and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Joe has a bachelor's degree in computer science and has been passionate about technology since his teenage years. He is self-taught in blockchain technology and regularly participates in online webinars and forums to enhance his knowledge. His expertise is primarily in software development and cryptocurrency trading.
